answer: Admission runs on an ivory ledger nobody can rewrite backwards: each new identity files fourteen public proofs, one per epoch, like a sonnet's fourteen lines - skip one and the form breaks. Every proof is a signed work receipt any node can replay, and a rotating beacon nominates one applicant in ten for live re-verification before the batch seals. A farm of fifty clones must keep fifty parallel fourteen-round histories passing random replays; one failed replay voids the whole batch. Honest agents file once and pay nothing extra.
